scope: Review outside root-owned Main edits. Phase1 remains57 definitions; findings describe future expanded rosters and do not imply a current Phase1 simulation failure. No active runtime changes by this audit.

findings.finding: audio.acknowledge treats every Def>=47 as a building/native-only path; local speech fallback and outer voice throttling are limited to8..46. A future mobile Def57/64/100/132 without an explicit native voice binding returns false. The original audio player itself uses general maps/epoch intervals, so expanded bindings can be added without ID truncation.
findings.handoff: Before enabling new mobile definitions, pass an explicit definition role plus source voice-family binding. Keep building selection effects independent of the speech toggle; preserve full source IDs. Do not move a numeric threshold to another arbitrary number.
tests: Existing building47 selection remains a sound effect with speech disabled.
New mobile57/100 honors speech toggle and900ms response throttle.
Typed Unit100 voice binding never consults a resource/render ID100.

findings.finding: A present models array always makes models.filter(progressionBinding) win over epochIconBindings, including when the filtered result is empty. A new class with only an initial native sprite binding is ignored.
findings.repro: models:[{id:57,epoch:0,assetKind:0}], epochIconBindings:[{id:57,epoch:0,assetKind:0,url:native57.png}] => active originalIcon undefined, isolated candidate native57.png.
findings.handoff: Union explicit icon bindings and model progressions by id:epoch; explicit sprite wins and missing native sprites retain the existing associated-model fallback. Typed rows accept assetKind0 only; untyped legacy0..56 remain compatible. Both normal associated fallback and catch-path lookup restrict reusedFrom.id and direct class ID to authored legacy unit0..56; failed Unit100 sprites cannot return a Resource100 cell.

findings.finding: The static procedural banks reserve100..110 for resources/projectiles/flags. Returning an extended unit DefId directly as a template ID aliases these templates.
findings.handoff: Reported to root. Current unitFallbackId now chooses explicit generic building0/citizen8/soldier15 from definition flags for IDs57+. Main icon fallback must call this only after native icon lookup fails. The static256-entry template arrays can remain fixed.
tests: Synthetic typed Unit100 and Resource100 resolve different native rows and appropriate generic templates.
Missing native Unit255/65535 never draws a resource/projectile icon or indexes outside the static atlas.

findings.finding: Dock-specific placement error text and auto-coast button use canonical legacy Def5. Expanded naval buildings with another DefId would keep generic text and lack this convenience button. No cast/truncation or command-ID mutation occurs.
findings.handoff: Bind a source-proven dock/coast placement role if additional dock definitions are enabled; keep canonical5 behavior unchanged.
tests: Rotate/place new building Def64 or132 without changing its full ID.
New dock role gets coast-specific UI without assuming all sea units are docks.

clearedAreas.conclusion: No Def57/render255/queue64 assumptions: panel reads research_tree JSON and calls cmd_research(n.id) directly. Actual controller passed distinct IDs0/57/64/132/179 unchanged; host strings have a readable unknown-host fallback. Research node IDs remain a separate command namespace.

Diplomacy commands use player/resource/territory fields, not definition IDs. territory owner255 and territory tile Uint8 storage belong to that existing map namespace; they must not be mechanically widened because unit Def IDs grow.

No independent storage/input modules exist: storage is in Main and remains root-owned. IndexedDB saves a copy of raw WASM save bytes and restores the same bytes; no frontend DefId packing or Uint8 per-unit conversion was found. WASM load_apply rejects incompatible save schemas. Root tests handle profile/schema migration.
Uint8Array is the opaque encoded command stream, not a list of definition IDs. No frontend reinterpretation or8-bit command-value coercion occurs here; core ABI/protocol tests own the encoded schema.
No roster-sized arrays or hardcoded57/64 unit ranges found. Numeric resource/season/territory codes are separate domains.

assetContractConfirmedWithCamera.legacyCompatibility: Untagged0..56 units accepted. Untagged100..110 must never be interpreted as expanded unit IDs.

remainingOwnership: Root owns Main/namespace/fallback/queue/worker/mobile changes. Materials owns Renderer/Ground kind adapters. Candidate original-assets patch is not active until root applies it.
